answer: Sybil resistance runs on a bond vault: each agent locks a stake for a fixed term, and only identities countersigned by a member in good standing get credited. Attestations are rationed, and the countersigner's bond is slashed if the recruit proves fake, so cloning costs deposits far above any reward. An attacker launching a thousand puppets from one jetty of keys must fund a thousand stakes and loses them once two keys vote in lockstep, flagged as one handler. Extra identities become liabilities, not multipliers, so honest members outrun any gale of fakes.
